title: Stochastic Deep Learning: A Probabilistic Framework for Modeling Uncertainty in Structured Temporal Data
abstract: arXiv:2601.05227v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: I propose a novel framework that integrates stochastic differential equations (SDEs) with deep generative models to improve uncertainty quantification in machine learning applications involving structured and temporal data. This approach, termed Stochastic Latent Differential Inference (SLDI), embeds an It\^o SDE in the latent space of a variational autoencoder, allowing for flexible, continuous-time modeling of uncertainty while preserving a principled mathematical foundation. The drift and diffusion terms of the SDE are parameterized by neural networks, enabling data-driven inference and generalizing classical time series models to handle irregular sampling and complex dynamic structure.   A central theoretical contribution is the co-parameterization of the adjoint state with a dedicated neural network, forming a coupled forward-backward system that captures not only latent evolution but also gradient dynamics. translated_abstract: 我提出了一个新颖的框架，将随机微分方程（SDE）与深度生成模型相结合，以改进涉及结构化和时序数据的机器学习应用中的不确定性量化。这种方法被称为随机潜变量微分推断，它将伊藤随机微分方程嵌入到变分自编码器的潜空间中，从而在保持有原则的数学基础的同时，实现对不确定性的灵活的连续时间建模。SDE的漂移项和扩散项由神经网络进行参数化，实现了数据驱动的推断，并将经典时间序列模型推广到能够处理不规则采样和复杂动态结构的情形。一个核心的理论贡献是将伴随状态与专用神经网络进行共同参数化，形成一个耦合的前向-后向系统，不仅能捕捉潜变量的演化，还能捕捉梯度动态。我引入了一个
tldr: 提出SLDI框架，将伊藤随机微分方程嵌入变分自编码器的潜空间，通过神经网络参数化漂移与扩散项并对伴随状态进行共同参数化，实现对结构化时序数据不确定性的连续时间灵活建模与量化。
en_tdlr: Proposes SLDI, a framework embedding an Itô SDE into the latent space of a variational autoencoder with neural-network-parameterized drift and diffusion terms and a co-parameterized adjoint state, enabling flexible continuous-time uncertainty quantification for structured temporal data.
